reasoning: Identity: EO 10509, Eisenhower, December 16, 1953 (18 FR 8471), confirmed from the held FR text and its signature line. The report cover names the order by number and date. Two clauses, complete. Dating: the cover date line reads cleanly as FEBRUARY 17, 1954. The letter's text layer reads 'February 27,1964.', but the rendered page image reads 'February 17, 1954' cleanly, so the cover-date route (or the letter itself) gives 1954-02-17, and the claim quotes the text-layer line and discloses the rule. Correct ends: the board clause by completion on 1954-02-17; the no-change clause on 1954-02-17 + 30 = 1954-03-19, inclusive, with the exclusive reading 1954-03-18 stated. The stipulated extension 'to and including February 17, 1954, and the President approved the stipulation' (no approval date) is disclosed as a source note. EO 12553 (February 25, 1986) is kept as the formal disposition, lists the order, and has no saving wording; the catalog note is only 'Revoked by: EO 12553'. All hashes and quoted spans match. The legal outcome is right; the claim is rejected only for the citation locator defect, a mechanical fix.
